entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Haghartsin is a medieval monastery located near the town of Dilijan in the Tavush Province of Armenia. It was built between the 10th and 13th centuries. It is composed of three churches: St. Gregory's, St. Stephen's, and St. Astvatsatsin, as well as a gavit and a refectory.
